rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Supermemory is an open-source AI knowledge platform that helps users collect, organize, and recall information from various sources. It integrates with popular tools like Notion, Twitter, Obsidian, and more, allowing users to save content, build a personal knowledge base, and use AI to chat with and search through their collected information while maintaining privacy through end-to-end encryption and optional self-hosting.
